entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to return something and I expect this to be handled now. Don't waste my time.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit support. I understand you'd like to make a return. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number?
It's VF-8675-309. I bought a helmet and I want my money back. I've had it for a couple of months, but the box is still unopened. It better not be an issue.
Thank you for that. Let me just pull up your order... VF-8675-309. Yes, I see it here. It's for the Apex Aero helmet, delivered on November 24th, which was 63 days ago.

And? I already told you the box is unopened! The color was just not what I wanted when it arrived. Are you going to give me a hard time about this? Because I will speak to your manager immediately if you start playing games. I'm not afraid to post my experience online.
I understand your frustration, sir, but there's no need for that. Let me just quickly confirm our return policy for you. One moment, please.
This is ridiculous. It's a simple return. Just process it.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked our knowledge base, and you're all set. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days after delivery.
Wait, what? So... you're just going to approve it? No hassle?

That's correct. Since you're at 63 days, you are well within the 90-day window. I've just initiated the return and a prepaid shipping label has been sent to the email on your account. Just attach it to the box and you can drop it off.
Oh. Well... alright then. That was... much easier than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. We want to ensure you're satisfied. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process your full refund. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Happy to help. We always want to make sure you have the right gear for your ride; your safety is our top priority. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
